index.summary: Remediate ten externally verified DogdouSpec governance and usability defects.

product.objective: Resolve F1 through F10 from the external dogfood field report so governance claims fail closed, mutation workflows are preflightable and consistent, managed state is reviewable, and durable knowledge has first-class CLI support.

deliverable.description: Correct vcs-status and checkpoint-plan for non-repositories and Git status failures.
Provide criterion authoring and reject activation or completion against undefined placeholders.

index.summary: Coherent mutation preflight, explanation, revision, and addressing behavior.

deliverable.description: Expose request validation and prospective checks while converging help, revision, and document addressing semantics.
Guarantee one trailing LF and stable structural indentation without changing prose text values.
Allow task add to accept structurally valid operational requests emitted by task quick dry-run.
Add knowledge add and list workflows and surface durable-fact capture at completion.
Version or compare workspace schema copies against embedded authoritative schemas.

included.item: Core mutation, iteration, task, workspace, validation, serialization, and knowledge services.
CLI command surfaces and accurate conditional help.
Core and CLI regression tests reproducing every field-report finding.
Documentation updates required to describe implemented behavior.

excluded.item: Automatic Git writes or weakening of owner authority gates.
Semantic hard-wrapping that changes XML text node values.
Removal of raw XML plumbing or existing read-only porcelain.
Unrelated schema redesign or compatibility-breaking command renames.

index.summary: Transport readiness must be established from successful Git evidence.

requirement.statement: Workspace transport status must fail closed when no Git repository exists or Git status cannot be obtained, while retaining correct success for clean checkpointed repositories.
requirement.rationale: F10 currently certifies transport readiness without any checkpoint destination or successful Git evidence.

index.summary: Product acceptance criteria must be authorable and defined before lifecycle gates.

requirement.statement: Owners must have first-class criterion authoring paths, and activation, readiness, and completion must reject blank or seeded placeholder criteria.
requirement.rationale: F2 permits an iteration to certify acceptance against a bar that was never written.

index.summary: Mutation requirements must be inspectable before writes and consistently addressed.

requirement.statement: Mutation requests must support coherent validation or dry-run and explain semantics, conditional requirements must be visible in help, and iteration, document, and revision addressing must follow one predictable model.
requirement.rationale: F1, F5, and F8 create avoidable trial-and-error and inconsistent concurrency handling.

index.summary: Managed XML must be byte-stable and structurally reviewable.

requirement.statement: All managed document writes must use canonical structural formatting with exactly one trailing LF while preserving exact prose text values.
requirement.rationale: F6 breaks consumer whitespace checks and F7 makes versioned governance state unreviewable.

index.summary: Canonical operational task requests must compose across CLI commands.

requirement.statement: Task add must accept any structurally valid single current-iteration supports origin, including canonical task quick dry-run output, independent of command-name provenance.
requirement.rationale: F4 rejects the CLI's own valid generated request because validation is tied to an entrypoint string.

index.summary: Durable knowledge must have first-class write and discovery commands.

requirement.statement: Knowledge entries must be addable and listable without hand-authored XML, with completion guidance prompting capture of facts that outlive an iteration.
requirement.rationale: F3 leaves durable cross-cutting knowledge trapped in closed task records.

index.summary: Workspace schema cache drift must be detectable.

requirement.statement: Validation must identify workspace schema copies that differ from the CLI's embedded authoritative schema set without making local cache drift silently authoritative.
requirement.rationale: F9 leaves independently copied workspace schemas unpinned across upgrades.

acceptance.criterion: In a non-Git directory, vcs-status and checkpoint-plan report locally durable but not transport-ready and enumerate authoritative files as uncheckpointed.
A failed Git status invocation produces a diagnostic and never reports a clean transport-ready workspace.
Owners can set meaningful acceptance criterion text, while create-and-activate, activation readiness, and completion fail closed on blank or seeded placeholder criteria.
Hand-authored mutation requests can be schema- and state-checked without writing, and supported dry-runs report their prospective target revision.
Mutation preconditions and conditional option pairings are discoverable before failure through explain output or accurate help.
Query, validate, task, backlog, and iteration confirmation use consistent iteration, document, and optional expected-revision addressing where safe.
Repeated mutations through every managed write path leave exactly one trailing LF and pass git diff --check in a consumer workspace.
Canonical serialization places structural siblings on stable separate indented lines without changing prose text-node values.
Unmodified XML emitted by task quick --dry-run is accepted by task add when its operational origin is structurally valid.
Knowledge entries can be added and listed through first-class commands, and completion output prompts durable-fact capture.
Validate reports workspace schema drift against embedded authoritative schemas and normal workspaces remain valid.
The full build and test suite passes with zero failures and confirmed prior usability improvements remain available.

confirmation.summary: Owner requested a governed remediation iteration based on the external dogfood field report.
